unresolved_added: The cover text reads 'Problem Chosen A' while the corpus manifest and filename classify this record as problem type B; the artifact retains manifest type B and records the source mismatch.
The summary says five improved rules, while section 7.4 defines four improved rules in addition to five basic rules.
The prose calls the occupancy time-space diagram Figure 8 while the page caption labels it Figure 6; later pages use Figure 8 for a lane-flow plot.
The printed right-front opportunity inequality repeats D_r,b,gap instead of the right-front symbol defined in the notation table.
The update equations and flowchart do not fully specify simultaneous lane-change conflict resolution or vehicle update ordering across lanes.
Open-boundary inflow, ramp-entry balance, and failed-entry handling are described in prose without a complete stochastic transition specification.
The extracted average-speed and speed-standard-deviation formulas have flattened indices and require visual source interpretation before numerical reuse.
The conclusion says signaling enhances safety although the immediately preceding discussion reports increased sharp-braking frequency.
The paper calls the aggregation fuzzy synthetic evaluation, but the displayed method uses coefficient-of-variation weights and distance from an ideal alternative without fuzzy membership grades.
The relative-deviation formula prints u_0i although the notation table and ideal vector imply a criterion-indexed u_0j; Table ?? is also an unresolved cross-reference.
The overall relative-deviation column in Table 7 is not derived or explained, so it cannot be independently reconstructed from the light and heavy columns.
The sensitivity claim lacks random seeds, replicate counts, Monte Carlo error, confidence intervals, and convergence evidence; maximum reported deviations reach about 16.6 percent.
The left-driving transfer assumes persistent asymmetric left/right lane-change willingness without empirical calibration and contains missing table references.
Ramp-flow conclusions are conditional on balancing entrance inflow with exit demand and on unreported simulation settings.
Agreement with common sense is used as validation without field trajectories, held-out data, or an external benchmark.
No executable code, frozen parameter file, initialization, raw output, seed, environment, or reproduction package is supplied.
